task_title: Level-5 passive UX: PASSIVE section, unlock announcement, VFX rescoping

plan_review.notes: Adversarial-lite review (gpt-5.4, high effort) verdict: approved_with_changes, no blocking issues. Alt A: put all unlock feedback (VFX+announcement) at the level-5 grant site only, remove applyPassive VFX entirely -- rejected, loses the equip-time activation cue for weapon-gated passives. Alt B: keep all VFX in applyPassive with new first-activation bookkeeping state -- rejected, adds persistent simulation state just for cosmetics, more invasive than this issue warrants. Alt C: split unlocked vs activated into two distinct VFX/announcement kinds -- rejected, larger scope than the issue requires; chosen unconditional-announcement + conditional-VFX split already satisfies the UX goal. divergence=minor: reviewer confirmed constraint compliance (no grant/prerequisite/stat/threshold/slot changes) and raised test-robustness/API-contract points, no re-architecture. Resolutions: (1) e2e single-frame sample now polls via waitForState for skillPassiveUnlocked kind, avoiding FIFO-ordering flakiness; (2) added double-fire regression test (weapon-gated milestone with matching weapon already equipped at grant time) proving exactly one VFX + one announcement; (3) getCurrentAnnouncement scope and announcement replay-on-HUD-reconstruction accepted as out-of-scope trade-offs consistent with existing bossAbilityCast precedent; (4) FIFO starvation under burst traffic accepted as an existing property of the shared queue, not introduced by this change.
